  SDK: google-cloud-documentai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: process_document
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS

  SDK: alibabacloud_ocr_api
  Interface: sdk

  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/document-intelligence/prebuilt/invoice

Option 5 — Mindee:
  Service: Mindee Invoice OCR
  SDK: mindee
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: parse, invoice
  Setup hints: MINDEE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.mindee.com/docs/python-sdk

output_text:
```python
import os
from google.cloud import documentai_v1 as documentai

def extract_invoice_fields(invoice_path: str) -> dict:
    """
    Extract vendor, date, total, and line items from an invoice using
    Google Document AI Invoice Parser.

    Args:
        invoice_path: Path to a local invoice PDF/JPEG/PNG file.

    Returns:
        Dictionary with keys 'vendor', 'date', 'total', and 'items'.
        Line items are returned as a list of dictionaries.
    """
    # Initialize Document AI client
    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()
    # Construct the full resource name of the processor
    processor_name = os.environ["DOCUMENTAI_PROCESSOR_ARN"]
    # Read the invoice file
    with open(invoice_path, "rb") as image:
        image_content = image.read()
    # Prepare the document request
    document = {"content": image_content, "mime_type": "application/pdf"}
    request = {"name": processor_name, "document": document, "document_pages": [{"pages": 1}]}
    # Call the Document AI API to process the document
    response = client.process_document(request=request)
    # Parse the response
    entities = response.document.entities
    vendor = next((e for e in entities if e.type_ == "vendor_name"), {"text": ""}).text.content
    date_str = next((e for e in entities if e.type_ == "invoice_due_date"), {"text": ""}).text.content
    total_str = next((e for e in entities if e.type_ == "total_amount"), {"text": ""}).text.content
    items = [
        {"description": itm.fields["item_description"].text.content,
         "quantity": int(itm.fields["item_quantity"].text.content),
         "unit_price": float(itm.fields["item_unit_price"].text.content),
         "line_total": float(itm.fields["item_total"].text.content)}
        for itm in entities if itm.type_ == "item"
    ]
    return {"vendor": vendor, "date": date_str, "total": total_str, "items": items}
```
